comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT. GitHub #645's design (mitcad#2415; opened with --open, never committed; tools/cli/shell-sharp-reported-test.cmake): Body1 (F6.b0), a loft (Loft1 F6) cut to a slot with round ends (Extrude1 F9), its top edges rounded 2 mm (Fillet1 F10; the rounding along the slot's end is one B-spline surface with a crease, split there by the shell). A closed shell (no face removed): the geometry kernel's offset of the slot's end and of the loft's face below it intersect in three pieces, of which it kept the middle one only, and the offsets of those faces got no face; it failed at any thickness (OCCT port patch 2415).
The inside of the slot's round end and of the loft's face below it (no face before).
The wall: the body (91667.5 mm3) less its closed offset 2 mm in (68937.2 in the OCCT lab, Sharp and Rounded alike).

The report's shell (mitcad#2462): the loft's top F6:side(c2)#1 removed, Inside 2 mm, Sharp. Every face round the top (the 2 mm rounding) meets it tangentially, and the wall is no thicker than the rounding: the rounding's offset lies under the top all along and never meets it. It failed ('the offset faces do not close up'); now the wall ends in strips along the normal from the top's edges to their offsets (OCCT port patch 2462), named after the removed top. The volume: the geometry kernel's 18284.9 mm3 in the OCCT lab (case 2462-top-open-met-tangentially), Sharp and Rounded alike.
Rounded, as the report also asks: the same wall.
1 mm, Sharp: 9595.7 mm3 in the OCCT lab (Rounded 9595.6).

3 mm, Sharp (mitcad#2494): the wall is thicker than the 2 mm rounding, whose faces vanish beside the top. Only the three roundings of four edges were found vanishing; the one along the slot's near round end (47 edges, its boundary split where the crease split and the slot's faces cut it) and the crease's 0.4 mm2 sliver (13 edges) were kept, and the offsets did not close. Now a face of four sides that are chains of edges vanishes too (OCCT port patch 2494), the walls' offsets meet the top, and the tiny edges of the top (0.000015 mm) keep both their vertices. 26653.3 mm3 in the OCCT lab. Rounded at 3 mm: below (mitcad#2535).
Built, with the shell's note that the wall is thinner than 3 mm beside the roundings (they curve in 2 mm from the sides, the inside of the wall is 3 mm in).

expect.error_contains: the wall is thinner than 3 mm beside

comment: 3 mm, Rounded (mitcad#2535): the wall along the slot's near round end has 21 edges across the vanishing rounding and sliver, the top 35. The arc join extended that wall to the top along the one edge each of the top's edges was paired with first, each extended edge got the whole section with the top, and the vertices between them had no place on it: a construction error ('Standard_ConstructionError'), and the cavity route ran. Now the wall's edges across are extended as one run with one section, the image of the top's edges there (OCCT port patch 2535). The same wall as Sharp (the body has no concave edge for the arc join to round): 26653.3 mm3 in the OCCT lab (case 2535-wall-chain-across-vanishing-rounding), with the same note.

expect.error_contains: the wall is thinner than 3 mm beside
